stories.explanation: Perspective relevée lors de l Investor Update.
stories.story_fr: GE Vernova anticipe 52 milliards de dollars de chiffre d affaires en 2028, contre 45 milliards dans son objectif précédent.
stories.story_en: GE Vernova now anticipates $52 billion of revenue by 2028, up from $45 billion previously.
stories.citation: Now anticipates $52B of revenue and 20% adjusted EBITDA margin* by 2028, up from $45B of revenue

stories.name_fr: Marge d EBITDA ajusté visée à 2028
stories.story_fr: GE Vernova vise une marge d EBITDA ajusté de 20 % en 2028, contre 14 % dans l objectif précédent.
stories.story_en: GE Vernova targets a 20% adjusted EBITDA margin by 2028, up from 14% previously.
stories.citation: 20% adjusted EBITDA margin* by 2028, up from $45B of revenue and 14% adjusted EBITDA margin

stories.story_fr: GE Vernova s attend à faire passer son carnet de commandes de 135 à environ 200 milliards de dollars d ici fin 2028.
stories.story_en: GE Vernova expects total backlog to grow from $135 billion to about $200 billion by year-end 2028.
stories.citation: Expects to grow total backlog from $135B to approximately $200B by year-end 2028

stories.explanation: Carnet du segment Électrification, doublé dans l objectif.
stories.story_fr: Le carnet du segment Électrification doublerait de 30 à 60 milliards de dollars d ici fin 2028.
stories.story_en: The Electrification backlog would double from $30 billion to $60 billion by year-end 2028.
stories.citation: doubling the size of Electrification backlog from $30B to $60B

stories.name_fr: Flux de trésorerie disponible cumulé 2025 à 2028
stories.explanation: Cumul visé après environ 10 Mds $ d investissements et de R&D.
stories.story_fr: GE Vernova attend au moins 22 milliards de dollars de flux de trésorerie disponible cumulé de 2025 à 2028, contre au moins 14 milliards auparavant.
stories.story_en: GE Vernova expects at least $22 billion of cumulative free cash flow from 2025 to 2028, up from at least $14 billion.
stories.citation: Expects to generate at least $22B of cumulative free cash flow* from 2025 to 2028, up from at least $14B

stories.name_fr: Turbines à gaz en carnet et réservations
stories.name_en: Gas turbine backlog and slot reservations
stories.explanation: Contrats et réservations de créneaux de production cumulés.
stories.story_fr: GE Vernova s attend à 80 gigawatts de réservations de créneaux et de carnet de turbines à gaz d ici fin 2025.
stories.story_en: GE Vernova expects 80 GW of combined gas turbine slot reservations and backlog by year-end 2025.
stories.citation: expects to reach 80 GW of combined slot reservation agreements and backlog1 by year-end

stories.story_fr: GE Vernova double son dividende trimestriel à 0,50 dollar par action, contre 0,25 dollar.
stories.story_en: GE Vernova doubles its quarterly dividend to $0.50 per share from $0.25.
stories.citation: declares a $0.50 per share quarterly dividend, payable in the first quarter of 2026

stories.explanation: Autorisation relevée, dont 3,3 Mds $ utilisés au 3 décembre 2025.
stories.story_fr: GE Vernova relève son autorisation de rachat d actions à 10 milliards de dollars, contre 6 milliards.
stories.story_en: GE Vernova raises its share repurchase authorization to $10 billion from $6 billion.
stories.citation: increases share repurchase authorization to $10B, from $6B
